overall_structure.value: Mechanically alloyed (milled) powder after 20 h: an intermediate milling state in which alloying is in progress. The intense Ni and Mn elemental peaks are no longer evident in the XRD pattern, whereas all low-intensity elemental peaks had already vanished after 5 h and Al largely dissolved by 15 h. A fully alloyed solid solution (BCC + γ-brass type) is only reported after 25 h, so at 20 h the powder is not yet a single-phase solid solution. Powder particles are markedly refined relative to earlier milling times (bulky/coarse at 10 h).
